useLuckPerms_comment: If true, reads tags as LuckPerms permissions (e.g. cobblelvlcap.cap_20) instead of vanilla commands tags.
defaultCap_comment: Base level cap used when the player has no cap tags.
byTag_comment: Map of player command tags to their level caps.
allowCommandBypass_comment: If true, commands ignore level caps.
enableExperienceCap_comment: If true, stops XP gain at cap.
enableTradeCap_comment: If true, blocks trades above cap.
denyPcToPartyAboveCap_comment: If true, denies moving PC pokemon to party above cap.
usePartyHighestAsCaptureCap_comment: If true, capture cap is based on highest party level.
denyBattleAboveCap_comment: If true, Pokemon above the level cap are temporarily disabled (fainted) during battles. If false, they can be used freely.
denyCaptureAboveCap_comment: If true, denies capture above cap.

captureExclusions.excludeLegendaries_comment: If true, legendary Pokemon are exempt from the capture cap.
captureExclusions.excludeShinies_comment: If true, shiny Pokemon are exempt from the capture cap.
captureExclusions.excludedSpecies_comment: List of species names (lowercase) that are exempt from the capture cap. Example: ["mewtwo", "lugia"]

messages.notPlayer: [CobbleLvlCap] This command must be executed by a player.
messages.battleCanceledAllOverCap: Combat annulé: Vos Pokémon dépassent le niveau {cap}
messages.captureNotAllowed: Vous ne pouvez pas effectuer cette action! lvl max: {cap}
messages.redirectedToPc: Le Pokemon lvl {level} a été redirigé vers votre PC (équipe lvl max: {cap})
messages.pcFullKeepParty: PC full! Keep in party (above cap).
messages.pcToPartyBlocked: Niveau trop élevé pour votre équipe (équipe lvl max: {cap})
